name: Contractor bid comparison
lead: The facade bids are matched item by item to the architect's specification: areas, options, performance, insurance and validity. The board gets a sourced comparison; the tool does not choose the contractor.

project.title: Facade renovation and rear wall insulation, Maple Court (fictional)

extracts.text: Facade area to treat: 1,420 m² (street and rear). Scaffolding included, with balcony protection.
Rear facade: external wall insulation on 610 m², thermal resistance R of 3.7 or more.
1,420 m²; scaffolding included; rear wall insulation 610 m², R = 3.7; total $312,800; duration 14 weeks.
1,280 m²; scaffolding included; rear wall insulation 610 m², R = 3.7; total $268,900; duration 10 weeks.
1,420 m²; scaffolding optional (+$38,500); rear wall insulation 610 m², R = 3.2; total $279,400 without the option; duration 12 weeks.
10-year liability cover valid Jan 1 to Dec 31, 2026. Trades covered: facade renovation, painting. External insulation not listed.
10-year liability cover valid Jan 1 to Dec 31, 2026. Trades covered: facade renovation, external wall insulation.
10-year liability cover valid Apr 1, 2026 to Mar 31, 2027. Trades covered: facade renovation, external insulation, masonry.
Budget approved by the board: $300,000 at most. Owners' vote on Mar 10, 2027, works to start in spring 2027.
Offer valid for 3 months from Sep 15, 2026.
Offer valid for 6 months from Oct 1, 2026.

items.t: Most complete bid: Northgate Facades, {bid_amount}. Reason: {reason}.
Eastline is the cheapest, but prices 140 m² less and its liability cover excludes the insulation: have it completed before comparing.
Stoneworks comes to $317,900 with the required scaffolding, offers R = 3.2 and its offer will have expired on the meeting date.
Board budget: {budget}. The bid put forward exceeds it by $12,800: approve or renegotiate.
Requests to send: corrected areas and a complete certificate from Eastline; a validity extension from Stoneworks. [TO SEND after your review].
Draft resolution for the {meeting_date} meeting: [TO COMPLETE, check the required majority in your bylaws].

contradictions.title: Eastline: priced area smaller than the specification
contradictions.impact: The lowest price covers 10% less facade: the comparison is skewed.
contradictions.action: Ask for a bid on 1,420 m².

contradictions.title: Eastline: liability cover without external insulation
contradictions.impact: If the insulation fails, the building would not be covered.
contradictions.action: Require a certificate covering the trade, or set the bid aside.

contradictions.title: Stoneworks: insulation performance too low
contradictions.impact: The bid does not match the specification.
contradictions.action: Ask for a variant at R 3.7 or more.

contradictions.title: Stoneworks: offer expired by the meeting date
contradictions.impact: Owners would vote on a price the contractor no longer stands by.

contradictions.title: Bid put forward is above the board budget
contradictions.impact: The board set a ceiling: going over it without approval can block the vote.
contradictions.action: Get the overrun approved or renegotiate.
